nodes.label: ModelArgs
nodes.desc: Dataclass of hyperparameters: dim, n_layers, n_heads, n_kv_heads for GQA, multiple_of, max_seq_len, max_batch_size.

nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.desc: Decoder-only model: ParallelEmbedding, n_layers TransformerBlocks, final RMSNorm, ColumnParallelLinear output head.

nodes.label: TransformerBlock
nodes.desc: Pre-norm residual block: x + attn(norm(x)) then h + ffn(norm(h)).

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Fairscale-based multi-head attention with wq/wk/wv/wo and grouped-query repeat of KV heads.

nodes.label: cache_k / cache_v
nodes.desc: Pre-allocated KV cache tensors sized (max_batch_size, max_seq_len, n_local_kv_heads, head_dim).

nodes.label: repeat_kv
nodes.desc: Expands n_kv_heads to n_heads via expand/reshape so GQA reuses each KV head n_rep times.

nodes.label: FeedForward
nodes.desc: SwiGLU MLP with w1/w2/w3 projections and hidden dim snapped to a multiple of 256.

nodes.label: RMSNorm
nodes.desc: x * rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) with a learned scale, computed in float32 then cast back.

nodes.label: precompute_freqs_cis
nodes.desc: Builds the complex64 RoPE frequency table for max_seq_len * 2 positions at init time.

nodes.label: apply_rotary_emb
nodes.desc: Views q/k as complex numbers, multiplies by broadcast freqs_cis, returns real tensors.

nodes.label: tok_embeddings
nodes.desc: Fairscale ParallelEmbedding sharding the vocab across model-parallel ranks.

nodes.label: output head
nodes.desc: ColumnParallelLinear projecting hidden states to vocab_size logits in float32.

nodes.label: causal mask
nodes.desc: Upper-triangular -inf mask built in Transformer.forward when seqlen > 1, hstacked for cache offsets.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.desc: SentencePieceProcessor wrapper exposing vocab size, bos_id, eos_id, pad_id.

nodes.label: encode
nodes.desc: Piece-encodes a string and optionally prepends BOS / appends EOS token ids.

nodes.label: decode
nodes.desc: Detokenizes a list of ids back to text via SentencePiece.

nodes.label: Llama
nodes.desc: Holds a built Transformer and Tokenizer; public API surface for text and chat inference.

nodes.label: Llama.build
nodes.desc: Static factory: init NCCL + model parallelism, glob *.pth shards, read params.json, construct model, load state dict.

nodes.label: fairscale MP init
nodes.desc: torch.distributed NCCL process group plus initialize_model_parallel(WORLD_SIZE).

nodes.label: torch.load shard
nodes.desc: Reads the rank's .pth checkpoint on CPU and asserts shard count matches model_parallel_size.

nodes.label: generate
nodes.desc: Token-level decode loop: pad batch, step Transformer over positions, sample, track eos_reached, trim to EOS.

nodes.label: sample_top_p
nodes.desc: Sorts softmax probs descending, zeroes tokens beyond cumulative top-p mass, renormalizes, multinomial-samples.

nodes.label: EOS stopping
nodes.desc: eos_reached tensor ORs (next_token == eos_id) outside prompt spans; loop breaks when all rows finished.

nodes.label: text_completion
nodes.desc: BOS-encodes raw prompts, calls generate, decodes to CompletionPrediction dicts.

nodes.label: chat_completion
nodes.desc: Validates alternating user/assistant dialogs, folds system prompts into <<SYS>>, renders [INST] template, calls generate.

nodes.label: [INST]/<<SYS>> tags
nodes.desc: B_INST/E_INST and B_SYS/E_SYS constants; special tags in user content are rejected as unsafe.

nodes.label: Message / Dialog
nodes.desc: TypedDicts for role/content messages and List[Message] dialogs; Role is a Literal of system/user/assistant.

nodes.label: example_chat_completion.py
nodes.desc: Fire CLI run under torchrun: Llama.build then chat_completion over six sample dialogs incl. unsafe-tag test.

nodes.label: example_text_completion.py
nodes.desc: Fire CLI for base models: Llama.build then text_completion over few-shot continuation prompts.

nodes.label: setup.py
nodes.desc: setuptools package 'llama' v0.0.1 installing requirements.txt via pip install -e .

nodes.label: requirements.txt
nodes.desc: Pins torch, fairscale, fire, sentencepiece and other runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.desc: Quick start: pip install -e ., gated download.sh, torchrun commands, MP table (7B=1, 13B=2, 70B=8).

nodes.label: download.sh
nodes.desc: wget/md5sum script that fetches .pth shards and tokenizer.model after license approval; links expire in 24h.
